name: web-spec-additions
description: HTML attributes and CSS properties from current specs that VS Code's built-in data doesn't have yet. Items are dropped once VS Code ships them.

enumDescriptions: Add nothing: VS Code's built-in CSS data only.
Add features that are Baseline: newly or widely available across browsers.
Also add features defined in a spec at Candidate Recommendation or later, or in a WHATWG Living Standard.
Also add features that are only in Working Drafts, Editor's Drafts or Community Group drafts.
webSpecAdditions.css.level.markdownDescription: Which CSS features this extension adds to VS Code's built-in data. Each level includes the ones above it. VS Code's own data is always used and can't be hidden. Applies after a window reload.

webSpecAdditions.css.proprietary.markdownDescription: Also add proprietary CSS features: vendor-prefixed, non-standard, or in no spec. Has no effect when `#webSpecAdditions.css.level#` is `off`.

webSpecAdditions.css.legacyNames.markdownDescription: Also add old names of renamed CSS properties that browsers still accept, such as `flow-tolerance` for `fit-tolerance`. They show as obsolete, and their hover points to the current name. Has no effect when `#webSpecAdditions.css.level#` is `off`.

enumDescriptions: Add nothing: VS Code's built-in HTML data only.
Add features that are Baseline: newly or widely available across browsers.
Also add features defined in a spec at Candidate Recommendation or later, or in a WHATWG Living Standard.
Also add features that are only in Working Drafts, Editor's Drafts or Community Group drafts.
webSpecAdditions.html.level.markdownDescription: Which HTML features this extension adds to VS Code's built-in data. Each level includes the ones above it. VS Code's own data is always used and can't be hidden. Applies after a window reload.

webSpecAdditions.html.proprietary.markdownDescription: Also add proprietary HTML features: vendor-prefixed, non-standard, or in no spec. Has no effect when `#webSpecAdditions.html.level#` is `off`.
